description_en: Creates a voice cloning task to initialize the basic configuration information for the task
description_zh: 创建人声克隆任务，用于初始化配置人声克隆任务的基础信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-customized-voice-job --voice-id xiaozhuan --gender female --scenario story --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomizedVoiceJob

parameters.help_en:
The custom voice ID (English name or pinyin of the voice).

The ID cannot be the same as any of your other custom voice IDs.
The ID cannot exceed 32 characters.
Only letters and numbers are supported
parameters.help_zh:
自定义的声音 Id （声音的英文或拼音）

不能和您其他的定制声音 Id 重名
不超过 32 个字符
仅支持字母和数字
parameters.name: voice_id

parameters.help_en:
The voice name (generally a Chinese name).
The name cannot exceed 32 characters
parameters.help_zh:
声音名字（一般为中文名）
不超过 32 个字符
parameters.name: voice_name

parameters.help_en:
The voice description.
The description cannot exceed 256 characters
parameters.help_zh:
声音描述
不超过 256 个字符
parameters.name: voice_desc

parameters.help_en:
The gender. Valid values:
female: female.
male: male
parameters.help_zh:
性别，取值范围：
female：女性
male：男性
parameters.name: gender

parameters.help_en:
The scenario. Valid values:
story: story.
interaction: interaction.
navigation: navigation
parameters.help_zh:
场景，取值范围：
story：故事
interaction：交互
navigation：导航
parameters.name: scenario

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
